# Log Loss：评价指标综合示例
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss,average_precision_score
y=np.array([0,1,0,1,0,1]);p=np.array([.1,.8,.3,.6,.4,.7])
print("Log loss:",log_loss(y,p))
print("Average precision:",average_precision_score(y,p))
for thresh in [.3,.5,.7]:
 pred=p>=thresh
 print("threshold",thresh,"TP",sum(pred&(y==1)),"FP",sum(pred&(y==0)))

# 公平性指标：评价指标综合示例
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss,average_precision_score
y=np.array([0,1,0,1,0,1]);p=np.array([.1,.8,.3,.6,.4,.7])
print("Log loss:",log_loss(y,p))
print("Average precision:",average_precision_score(y,p))
for thresh in [.3,.5,.7]:
 pred=p>=thresh
 print("threshold",thresh,"TP",sum(pred&(y==1)),"FP",sum(pred&(y==0)))
